work_experience.description:
I am a software engineer with extensive experience in building reliable and scalable automation solutions for the food delivery and service industry. I have successfully developed automation systems for Master Kebab, integrating with the iiko provider to streamline operations from order processing to delivery.
My expertise includes:
- Building Telegram bots for customer and courier interaction
- Automating courier logistics and dispatch workflows
- Creating HR management tools
- Developing loyalty systems and integration with map services
- Implementing notification services, SMS gateways, and payment system integrations
I have delivered software with a 99.99% success rate and high system stability. My platforms have handled over 100,000+ completed orders, and the number is rapidly growing.
I thrive in fast-paced environments, value clean and maintainable code, and focus on creating products that solve real business problems with measurable impact.
